body.name: FrontierHandle
body.def: Start from the proved bound \(D_2(n)\leq U_2(n)\) on the unchanged class \(\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(n)\), decide whether \(\sup_nD_2(n)\) is finite, compute the least constant in the bounded branch, and in the unbounded branch require a generically birational indegree-two family satisfying \(\binom n2-|B|\geq|D|\) together with an order-robust proper degree closure.
